race.comment: SLEEPING TIGER (3) got a long way off them when first up here. He can easily improve into this and has run some good races second up. IRRESISTIBLE SIR (2) only ran last week but this time around draws a much softer barrier. He might do more this run. CHARMING DI (10) is one who could show sharp improvement. She is a winner at Moe, has faced a few wet tracks and done little and was not far behind on the dry recently. Value hope. LAURA'S GOLD (9) at least was not far away at Ballarat. Not a great gate though. BLEAK MID WINTER (1) returns from a lay-off. Ran fourth in a jump-out at Sale. Opened last campaign with a sixth at Cranbourne over 1000m. In the mix fresh.
